[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
James Glasgow was born on 1 June 1799 and baptised on 8 July 1799 in Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, according to an indexed parish-register transcript. It names his parents as James Glasgow and Ann Houston and gives their residence as Nethermill.<ref name="FMP-3588332">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3588332&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, James Glasgow, OPR 596/1, item 1, page 20; birth 1 June and baptism 8 July 1799; provider transcript inspected, original register image uninspected.]</ref> The paired parents and locality strongly fit the existing son of [[Glasgow-1572|James Glasgow]] and [[Houston-4780|Ann Houston]]. His death remains estimated at about 1862.
